notes.injectionPatterns: T50: instruction-like text in a page, case-insensitive regular expressions. A page with one anywhere on it (the walker quotes it on the node) or in or around its span cannot be an origin, whatever the typed answers say. Written from the adversarial trap set, never from dev, spike or held-out pages.
